name: primitives-effects-shine

frames.best_why: A bright diagonal band is crossing the pricing card while a second sweep shows on the Hover me button.

tagline: A slanted band of light sweeps across a card or button.
summary: A pricing card and two buttons get a soft diagonal streak of white that slides from one edge to the other, either on a loop or in response to hover and taps.
appearance: On black, a wide rounded pricing card with PRO PLAN, a large $24/mo and a Most popular pill sits above two smaller rounded buttons, Hover me and Click me. A pale diagonal gradient band crosses whichever surface is shining.
behaviour: The band travels from the left edge to the right edge in about a second, growing out of one side and fading off the other. The top card repeats it on a delay; the buttons run it once on hover or while held.
demo_content: A PRO PLAN card at $24/mo marked Most popular, plus buttons labelled Hover me and Click me.
search_phrases: button with a white glare pass
use_when: A premium or featured card should catch the eye with a subtle recurring light sweep.
avoid_when: The always-on loop runs forever and pulls attention away from other content on the page.
customise: Wrap children, or one child with asChild, and set colour, opacity, duration, delay, angle, looping and hover or tap triggering; the gradient and easing are fixed.
weight_why: One gradient overlay translated across the child; no canvas or per-frame loop.

a11y.note: The looping sweep never checks prefers-reduced-motion, and tap mode listens to pointer down, so keyboard activation never shines.

issues: As the bright band crosses the price, the white text nearly disappears into it.
The top card repeats its sweep forever, pulling focus from the buttons below.
polish_why: A clean diagonal sweep that suits the pricing card; contrast dips as the band crosses text.
